scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street with tall buildings, pedestrians, and parked scooters. The street has a bike lane and pedestrian crossing. There are trees lining the sidewalk and a few people walking around. The buildings have balconies and windows. The street is paved with asphalt and has white markings. The sun is shining. The sky is overcast. The street is busy with people going about their daily business.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are multi-story structures made of stone and brick. They have balconies and windows. Some have awnings. The street is lined with trees. People are walking along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has white markings. The buildings have a mix of stone and brick facades. Some have balconies and windows. The street is lined with trees.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are benches and trash cans along the sidewalk. A scooter is parked near the curb.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are leafy and well-maintained. They provide shade and beauty to the area.
scene_analysis.signage: There are signs indicating the name of the street and businesses. Some have arrows pointing to directions.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking in both directions. Some are sitting on benches.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is bustling with activity. People are out and about.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is lined with shops and cafes. The architecture is beautiful.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is a great place to relax.
